newsitem.title: USA: Innovasive to acquire Medicine Lodge.
newsitem.headline: Innovasive to acquire Medicine Lodge.

text.p: Innovasive Devices Inc Tuesday said it will acquire Medicine Lodge Inc for 1.885 million shares of Innovasive Devices common stock.
The Board of Directors of both companies unanimously approved an asset purchase agreement for Medicine Lodge.

Logan, Utah-based Medicine Lodge designs, develops and manufactures proprietary implantable medical devices and related instrumentation used in the minimally invasive arthroscopic procedures to repair injuries of the knee and shoulder.
The transaction is expected to close during the second calendar quarter of 1997 and is subject to the approval of the shareholders of Innovasive Devices.
